headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to look at how climate change could create financial risks.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with financial risks linked to climate change. Based on its title, it directs the federal government to pay attention to how climate-related events could affect money, investments, or the financial system. No summary was provided, so specific requirements and deadlines cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are likely directed to study or address climate-related financial risk, though the exact tasks are not described in the material provided.
